Calling all builders of Uniswap v4 hooks!

We are excited to announce that applications for the Uniswap Foundation Security Fund (UFSF) will open November 11!

From Nov 11 to Nov 29, 2024 23:59 UTC, projects building Uniswap v4 hooks can apply to receive a subsidy for security audit services under the $1M UFSF. If this sounds interesting to you or someone from your network, you can declare your interest by completing this intent form.

How will it work?
Selected applicants will gain access to subsidized security services from the list of whitelisted security providers in a dedicated audit services marketplace. Since the auditing firms are competing for conducting the audits, projects can choose from the highest-quality services. You can find all these important details and more in the UFSF Notion Hub here.

Additionally, you can stay connected to any updates by joining the Builders’ Telegram channel here.

  1. Submit your application during the application window
  2. Selected projects gain access to our dedicated audit services marketplace
  3. Choose from whitelisted security providers competing to offer the best services
  4. Receive substantial subsidies (up to 100%) for your security audit needs

  • Build with confidence in the Uniswap ecosystem
  • Benefit from competitive pricing and services through our marketplace model

Resources

  • Express Interest: Declaration Form
  • Detailed Information: Uniswap Foundation Security Fund (UFSF)
  • Community Updates: Builders’ Telegram Channel

If you have any questions, feel free to share them in the comments below or reach out through the Builders’ Telegram channel.

Uniswap Foundation Security Fund Cohort 2 Projects Applications Are Now Open!

Dear Uniswap Ecosystem Builders,

We’re excited to announce that applications for Cohort 2 of the Uniswap Foundation Security Fund (UFSF) are now open! This subsidy fund is designed to make security accessible to all projects building in the Uniswap ecosystem by covering up to 100% of audit costs.

Key Dates

Applications are open now and will close on March 5, 2025, 23:59 UTC.

Success Stories from Cohort 1

Our first cohort demonstrated the vital importance of accessible security audits. Here’s what some subsidy recipients shared:

  1. “Security is always the priority. You can miss a marketing opportunity or deadline and recover. It’s much harder to recover trust after a hack.” - Bunni Protocol (Bunni - The Shapeshifting Exchange)​

  2. “The audit allows us to move forward with confidence, knowing that our code meets the highest standards of security, so we can focus more on user education and growth.” - Unicord - Lumisfi (@lumisfi_)

  3. “The UFSF audit allows us to go to audit faster in order to audit the core interest rate AMM piece of the Tenor protocol.” - Tenor Finance (Tenor FinanceTenor)​

Who Can Apply?

For Cohort 2, we’ve expanded eligibility to include ALL projects building in the Uniswap ecosystem, including but not limited to:

  • v4 hooks

  • Unichain

  • And more!

How The Fund Works

  1. Application & Review: Submit your project for consideration. Our team evaluates applications based on technical merit and ecosystem impact.

  2. Selection & Marketplace Access: Selected projects gain entry to our dedicated security services marketplace.

  3. Provider Selection: Browse and select from our curated list of top-tier security providers. These providers compete to offer their services, ensuring competitive pricing and high quality.

  4. Subsidized Services: Receive up to 100% coverage for your security audit costs, significantly reducing the financial barrier to securing your project.

Why Apply?

  • Access premium security services without the premium price tag

  • Choose from multiple respected security providers

  • Benefit from a competitive marketplace environment

  • Receive support throughout the audit process

  • Build with confidence in the Uniswap ecosystem

Submit your application here: https://areta.fillout.com/cohort-2-projects

Additional Resources

  • Detailed Information: UFSF Notion Hub

  • Project Updates: Telegram Channel

If you have further questions, Join our Telegram channel for updates and support. Our team is ready to help you navigate the application process.

Launch of Uniswap Open Marketplace & UFSF Cohort 3 Applications

Dear Uniswap ecosystem builders,

Together with the Uniswap Foundation, we’re excited to announce the launch of the Uniswap Open Marketplace on Areta Market - a new procurement platform designed to make security audits faster, cheaper, and more transparent for Uniswap ecosystem builders.

What Is Areta Market?

A security audit marketplace that:

  • Connects builders to a whitelisted set of top-tier audit firms
  • Delivers 10–12 competitive quotes per request
  • Offers 20–30% average cost savings
  • Reduces audit procurement timelines from weeks to days

Since inception and working with the first two cohorts of UFSF, the marketplace has:

  • 175 audit offers processed, worth over $16M
  • $1M in audit subsidies allocated to 15 Uniswap ecosystem projects
  • 60+ audit firms applied, with 25 whitelisted

Uniswap Foundation Security Fund - Cohort 3 Now Open

As of today, the Uniswap Foundation Security Fund (UFSF) is live on Areta Market and open to all Uniswap and Unichain builders.

Important Note:

  • All projects interested in participating in UFSF Cohort-3 must complete the separate application form linked below and also submit a request on the marketplace.
  • Projects selected for Cohort-3 will be able to access their subsidy through the marketplace.

Key details:

  • Up to 100% subsidy on your next audit
  • Deadline: June 7, 2025 – 23:59 UTC
  • Apply here: Application Form

posts.cooked:
Call for Applications: Uniswap Foundation Security Fund – December Cohort

The Uniswap Foundation Security Fund (UFSF) is now accepting applications for the December cohort. This program supports teams building within the Uniswap ecosystem by providing subsidized access to high-quality smart-contract audits.

With the introduction of Uniswap v4 Hooks, developers can integrate advanced custom logic such as dynamic fees, bespoke liquidity curves, and external contract interactions. While this significantly expands design space and innovation potential, it also increases the complexity and associated security risks. For many early-stage teams, the cost of a comprehensive audit can be prohibitive. The UFSF is designed to remove this barrier and ensure teams can build and deploy safely.

What the Program Offers

  • Up to 100% coverage of audit costs for eligible projects.

  • Access to a curated marketplace of 25 vetted, leading security providers, enabling teams to receive competitive bids and select auditors best suited to their needs.

Key Details

  • Application Deadline: 07 December 2025

  • Application Form: https://areta.fillout.com/ufsf-projects

Teams building Uniswap v4 Hooks, projects deploying on Unichain, or other initiatives meaningfully contributing to the Uniswap ecosystem are strongly encouraged to apply.
